posts.text:
He is risen. ✝️ 

“For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.” John 3:16

Wishing a blessed Easter to South Carolina. 🙏

This will be a movie one day. Insane challenges. Incredible success. Unlike anything we've ever seen. 🇺🇸


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

🚨“WE GOT HIM! My fellow Americans, over the past several hours, the United States Military pulled off one of the most daring Search and Rescue Operations in U.S. History, for one of our incredible Crew Office Members, who also happens to be a highly respected Colonel, and who I am thrilled to let you know is SAFE and SOUND!” - President Donald J. Trump 🇺🇸

America does not leave its own behind. Our BRAVE U.S. soldiers rescued AND evacuated the F15 WSO from Iran.

We continue to pray for all our soldiers in harm’s way and pray for their safe return. We pray for those who sacrificed their lives, and gave all, in this mission. 

In the face of danger, the U.S. military proves exactly why it is the strongest, most capable fighting force in the world. 

God Bless America 🇺🇸

The United States does not abandon the men and women who answer its call. Not on the battlefield. Not ever.

Many unconfirmed reports on the F15 rescue and evacuation operation tonight - please PRAY for our soldiers - and all American troops in harms way. Please PRAY for the safe return of every single one and PRAY for those who sacrificed it all.

GOD BLESS AMERICA. 🇺🇸

Our subpoena stands.

The American people deserve answers on the Epstein files: no redactions, no cover-ups. We will NEVER back down on survivors, and we will do everything in our power to ensure they get justice and predators are held to the fullest extent of the law.

Video

Too many women who escape dangerous situations end up buried in IRS notices for taxes they never knew were owed, facing penalties for infractions they did not commit, and being held liable for returns signed under duress.

We introduced the Tax Fairness for Abuse Survivors Act to ensure survivors are not forced to carry the financial consequences of their abuser.

When we heard our U.S. special forces went in and successfully rescued one of our service members after the jet went down over Iran, it underscored the incredible investment America has made in the greatest fighting force in the world.

We’re continuing to pray for the second service member to be found swiftly. Our prayers are with them and their family this Easter weekend.

Video

During our time in Congress, we have never voted to raise your taxes.

We will never support legislation taking more money from hardworking Americans. Your money belongs in your pockets, not Washington’s.

South Carolina STRONG.

MACE WIN: $1.8 million secured for Berkeley County first responders.

Berkeley County is one of the fastest-growing communities in South Carolina, with the Cooper River and Lake Moultrie right in its backyard. When emergencies happen on the water, seconds matter and the right equipment saves lives.

Our office supported Berkeley County’s Military Enhancement Fund grant to deliver two fire boats and a heavy-duty tow vehicle.

First responders in the Lowcountry deserve the best equipment available

We sat down with President Matthew Emmer from Coastal Refuges, a nonprofit doing incredible work advocating for refuges across the Savannah and South Carolina area, alongside the US Fish and Wildlife Service.

There is no place like the Lowcountry, and there are people fighting every single day to make sure it stays protected and preserved for generations to come. Conservation is personal, to our home, our marshes, our waterways, and our wildlife.

South Carolina STRONG.

We look forward to an Attorney General who restores law and order and holds rich and powerful predators accountable. 

The American people deserve results. No more two-tiered justice system.

RELEASE THE EPSTEIN FILES.

Video

MACE WIN: We've secured $944.8 MILLION in NDAA authorizations for Lowcountry military installations since coming to Congress.

The Lowcountry is a leader when it comes to national defense and is home to one of the largest military populations in the country. 

South Carolina STRONG.

We’re praying for our servicemembers overseas right now and for the aircrew whose plane was shot down in Iran today. 

It is far past time we bring our troops home.
The top prosecutor MUST hold predators accountable. The American people deserve answers.

Thanking God and U.S. forces for the rescue of one of our servicemembers after their aircraft was shot down over Iran today.

We are praying for a full recovery and for the safe return of the still-missing pilot.

Our military is the strongest and best in the world. God bless our brave troops and the United States of America.
